paragraphs.text: Hilario Zepeda Montaño participated in Seizure MZN-10-03 on 2010-03-14. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Seizure MZN-10-03 on 2010-03-14. Seizure MZN-10-03 occurred at Manzanillo on 2010-03-14. Liaison reporting received from a naval contact in Manzanillo described a second search of the fishing vessel Pesquero Vela Blanca during which inspectors recovered 80 kg of cocaine from a compartment missed in the first search. The liaison attributed both loads to Zepeda, the network's Lázaro Cárdenas plaza boss, and described the vessel as a regular visitor to both ports.

Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. The liaison contact described Anzures as the figure to whom the vessel's owner answered and stated that the owner had been instructed not to contest the seizure. The contact had no information on whether the loss was charged to Zepeda personally.

The reporting office assesses the liaison contact as reliable on port activity but notes that the contact's information on network leadership is secondhand. No operational tasking should be based on this reporting without further validation. The reporting office requests that any related seizure data be shared with the originating desk. Further reporting is expected as the liaison channel remains active. The contact added that the vessel was released to its owner after the search and that no arrests were made, which the contact attributed to pressure from a customs official whose identity the contact did not know. The contact assessed that the two searches of the same vessel on the same day reflected poor coordination between the inspecting units rather than a deliberate second look.
